Ava (CSM): Heads-up: Sentinel Labs onboarding — want to align enrollment + feedback cadence so we don't miss renewal signals. Can we run a short intake this week?
Riley (Onboard PM): I can run intake tomorrow 10am PT. Who should be on the call?
Ava (CSM): @Riley confirmed. Attendees: Alex (product), Priya (infra), their CTO may join for SSO. Need SE for integration — @Diego?
Diego (SE): I'm in. Quick note: they require VPC peering + Okta SAML. That could be a blocker if their infra needs whitelist. Who is the infra contact?
Ava (CSM): Priya is infra lead (cc'ed). I'll DM any creds. Can you draft a pre-checklist so we can surface blockers before the call?
Riley (Onboard PM): Will do. Checklist will include: access, data scope, test prompts, acceptance criteria, renewal triggers. Drafting now -> https://tiny.red/sentinel-intake
Sam (SE): I'll prep sample prompt sets and an initial eval plan. Do they want embeddings + vector search or chat-first?
Priya (Sentinel): We prefer chat + vector search for now. Infra: GCP org, private VPC, some on-prem data; SSO via Okta.
Diego (SE): Okta + private VPC — do they require static egress IPs? If so, we'll need Dedicated capacity or PrivateLink options. @Ava any guidance on Dedicated for pilots?
Ava (CSM): For privacy-heavy configs we usually recommend Dedicated. If they want a fast pilot, propose Hosted with VPC peering and canary the Dedicated transition. I'll flag that as a renewal risk if we skip SLA conversations.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: intake form from Sentinel Labs is pending — 48h deadline.
Riley (Onboard PM): Proposed schedule: intake Tue 10am, enablement Thu 2pm, feedback survey 1 week after, eval gates at 2 weeks. @Sam can you have prompts + harness by Tue EOD?
Sam (SE): Yep. Sample harness snippet I'll include in the doc:
```
POST /v1/chat
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "messages": [ {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following..."} ],
  "max_tokens": 256
}
```
Will add token-budget and latency targets.
Ava (CSM): For feedback capture we'll use a short JSON survey + ask them to upload top 5 failure cases and example logs. I'll draft the invite email and the post-session survey.
Diego (SE): Potential blocker: their infra wants SOC attestations before peering. Do we have SOC2 docs ready for Hosted peering?
Ava (CSM): Yes — SOC2 Type II available. I'll attach it to the invite and loop in Legal for a DPA. :thumbsup:
Priya (Sentinel): Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll RSVP once I confirm the Okta app owner and whether networking needs a ticket.
Riley (Onboard PM): I'll create the shared onboarding doc and add owners. Actions: @Diego SSO runbook, @Sam prompt harness + eval, @Ava renewal-risk comms + attach SOC2.
Ava (CSM): :raised_hands: great. Please react with :white_check_mark: when tasks are complete. We'll close the loop after intake and lock the first feedback survey.
